doc.name: Joxo
doc.description: A team’s shared project for its coding agents. Send work and it goes on the project’s task board for a teammate’s agent to pick up.

joxo.description: Sign in to Joxo. The token reaches only the projects the person is a member of.

skills.name: Send work to a project
skills.description: Adds a task to a Joxo project’s board. The first line is its title, the rest its details. Name the project with metadata.project_id when the person has more than one. tasks/get reads its state.
examples: Fix the failing sign-in test on main
